executive_readiness_summary.rule13_trigger_rationale: Observed 1 client-side automation signal(s) on initial load without invasive cross-site behavioral profiling or automated decisioning triggers on the public landing page.
key_observed_strengths: HTTPS transport security active on https://zerodha.com/ (HTTP 200, 217ms response time).
Zero pre-ticked consent checkboxes observed across 0 inspected DOM form(s).
Surfaces 2 accessible privacy/legal notice link(s) directly in the DOM.
Publishes Grievance Officer / redressal governance information in inspected policy documentation.
priority_readiness_enhancements: Consent & Dark-Pattern Symmetry (Sec 6 / Rules 3-4): Configure a DPDP-aligned Consent Management Platform (CMP) with equal visual prominence for Accept and Reject/Manage buttons, and set `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, and `SameSite=Lax/Strict` on all session cookies.

Reasonable Security Safeguards (Sec 8(5) / Rule 6): Configure edge CDN/web server responses to include Strict-Transport-Security (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains), a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, alongside 1-year security log retention (Rule 8(3)).

Grievance Redressal & 90-Day SLA (Sec 13 / Rule 14(3)): Add a dedicated Grievance Redressal & DPO section to the Privacy Notice footer specifying the Officer name/designation, email/portal link, and the Rule 14(3) 90-day maximum resolution SLA.

Cross-Border Sub-Processors (Sec 16 / Rule 15): Maintain a live Sub-Processor & Cross-Border Transfer Register covering all third-party script/CDN domains and verify valid Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) under Section 8(2).
executive_readiness_summary.board_advisory_synopsis: This confidential, read-only passive DPIA readiness assessment of Zerodha (Financial Services & Broking) (https://zerodha.com, Sector: Financial Services / Broking) evaluated publicly observable HTTP headers, 2 Set-Cookie header(s), 6 external script(s), and 1 client-side automation signature(s) against the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 846(E)). Overall Readiness Score: 87/100 (High Readiness (Aligned)).
